_about: Which daemons float in battle (T-452, 2026-11-06). Each row is decided from the daemon's FRONT drawing: only one drawn flying, hovering or levitating (wings spread off the ground, ghosts, orbs, a moon) keeps a lift; anything standing, sitting or perched is 0, and 0 when in doubt. tools/gbaelevation.py writes the engine's src/data/pokemon_graphics/enemy_mon_elevation.h from this file and fails when they disagree. 'front' is a hash of the drawing's silhouette when it was decided: a floater redrawn since must be looked at again. A species not listed is 0.
